title: Descriptive Sentence Ladder - Terrariums
hp: Copy it in your book or type it on screen, then expand and improve one descriptive sentence at a time.
h2: Build a descriptive sentence about terrariums from Level 1 to Level 3
intro: Tap a level to reveal it, then copy the sentence into your book or into the box. Students can compare how each version becomes more descriptive.

levels.label: Level 1: Base sentence
levels.say: Level 1. Copy the base sentence into your book or into the box.
levels.text: A terrarium is a miniature garden.
levels.ans: A terrarium is a miniature garden.

levels.label: Level 2: Add a location
levels.say: Level 2. Copy the sentence, then add a location.
levels.text: A terrarium is a miniature garden growing inside a glass jar.
levels.ans: A terrarium is a miniature garden growing inside a glass jar.

levels.label: Level 3: Add descriptive details
levels.say: Level 3. Copy the sentence, then add descriptive details.
levels.text: A terrarium is a miniature, lush garden growing inside a small glass jar.
levels.ans: A terrarium is a miniature, lush garden growing inside a small glass jar.

levels.label: Full Sentence: Fully descriptive sentence
levels.say: Copy the fully descriptive sentence into your book or into the box.
levels.text: A terrarium is a miniature, lush garden growing inside a small glass jar that creates its own humid ecosystem.
levels.ans: A terrarium is a miniature, lush garden growing inside a small glass jar that creates its own humid ecosystem.

bh: Challenge: Put the descriptive sentence back together
bsay: Challenge. Put the words in order to make the descriptive sentence.
bsmall: Tap the chips in order to build the fully expanded sentence.
ans: A terrarium is a miniature, lush garden growing inside a small glass jar that creates its own humid ecosystem.
